title: gepa: FlashRSI policy port
note: Delayed platform-measured study-feedback port; not native reproduction. See methods/flashrsi_ports/README.md for per-method mechanisms and differences.

preserved: Per-task frontier ownership, redundant-tie pruning and task-ownership-weighted parent sampling.
Instruction novelty and strict/improvement-or-equal paired study acceptance.
adapted: Platform measures candidates between external-method calls; only adaptation-visible study channel is read.
Candidate trees are staged artifacts; historical parents are restored from platform states.
missing_until_runtime_support: Native within-call evaluator callbacks and separate dev capability; no held-out score or gold exposure.
Native fresh parent/minibatch screen followed by separate dev evaluation is replaced by delayed full study-set paired acceptance.
Metric-call-budget allocation and shuffled/padded epoch minibatches are not reproduced; the platform controls measured-state budget.
System-aware merge is refused, matching the pinned FlashRSI implementation.

deviations.what: Method evaluation callbacks are replaced by delayed platform measurements.
deviations.why: INTERFACE.md §4 prohibits a method from evaluating benchmark tasks. The bridge reads only staged study records and returns whole candidates; it never invents a dev fitness or evaluates a held-out task.

deviations.what: Native fresh parent/minibatch screen followed by separate dev evaluation is replaced by delayed full study-set paired acceptance.; Metric-call-budget allocation and shuffled/padded epoch minibatches are not reproduced; the platform controls measured-state budget.; System-aware merge is refused, matching the pinned FlashRSI implementation.
deviations.why: The source strategy and prompts are pinned under methods/flashrsi_ports/vendor; README maps each source stage to this runtime and declares every unavailable stage.
